description: This file contains utility functions and enums for grid sampling operations in PyTorch, including checks for input validity, dimension validation, and device compatibility.

classes.name: GridSamplerInterpolation
classes.description: Enumeration for interpolation modes in grid sampling (Bilinear, Nearest, Bicubic).

classes.name: GridSamplerPadding
classes.description: Enumeration for padding modes in grid sampling (Zeros, Border, Reflection).

methods.name: check_grid_sampler_common
methods.description: Validates common conditions for input and grid tensors in grid sampling.

methods.name: check_grid_sampler_2d
methods.description: Checks that input and grid are 4D tensors suitable for 2D grid sampling.

methods.name: check_grid_sampler_3d
methods.description: Checks that input and grid are 5D tensors suitable for 3D grid sampling, with additional validation for bicubic interpolation.

methods.name: cond_cudnn_grid_sampler
methods.description: Determines if cudnn can be used for grid sampling based on tensor types, device compatibility, and size constraints.
